subject: Billing metadata & purchase-order attribute checklist for Brightforge deployment
messages:
From: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@brightforge.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@brightforge.com
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Billing metadata & PO attribute checklist for Redwood deployment

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the demo last week — the team is keen to move forward. Our procurement group needs a short checklist of the invoice fields and PO attributes Redwood requires so we can populate our ERP and spin up the master PO.

Specifically, can you confirm:
- Required PO fields (e.g., remit address, tax ID, contact, currency, GL code)
- Acceptable invoice cadence (monthly/quadratically/one-off) and any minimums or thresholds
- Net terms you can accept (Net30/45/60) and whether discounts are tied to prepayment or annual commit
- Whether you can support split invoices across multiple Brightforge cost centers under a single contract
- Any unique invoice metadata Redwood needs (usage_period, contract_id, po_reference fields)

I attached our standard PO template for reference (procurement@brightforge.com copied). If it helps, we can hop on a 30-min call with finance to walk through the ERP fields.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Lang
Director, Strategic Procurement
Brightforge Inc.
[Attachment: BRIGHTFORGE_PO_Template_2026_v1.docx]

From: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@brightforge.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing metadata & PO attribute checklist for Redwood deployment

Hi Sarah — thanks for the template and the clear list. Looping in Vanessa (AM) and Marissa (Finance lead) to make sure we map this cleanly.

High level answers below; I included an attached checklist that maps Brightforge fields -> Redwood invoice fields and two acceptable billing flows.

Summary (quick):
- Required PO attributes: vendor name (Redwood Inference Inc.), remit address, Redwood tax ID (EIN: 26-XXXXXXX), PO number, bill-to entity, currency, invoice contact name + email, and contract reference (we use Contract ID).
- Invoice cadence: default is monthly billing for hosted usage + any monthly reserved capacity charges. We can do quarterly consolidation for committed contracts on request.
- Net terms: Standard enterprise options are Net30 or Net45; Net60 is possible but requires Finance sign-off and a small program deposit or premia for terms beyond Net45.
- Discounts & packaging: discounts are tied to committed $ value or term length (example: 8% for 6-month commit, 15% for annual commit). Discounts applied as line-item credit on invoices; prepayment/annual billing gets highest discount.
- Split invoice support: we support either (1) single master PO + line-level cost center metadata on each invoice, or (2) multiple POs per BU but must be listed on the master contract and sent to finance for mapping.
- Invoice metadata we require: invoice.po_number, invoice.contract_id, invoice.usage_period (YYYY-MM), invoice.cost_center (optional but recommended), invoice.currency.

Attached: REDWOOD_PO_Mapping_Checklist_2026.xlsx (maps your template fields to what our system emits) and a sample SOW for the committed capacity.

Next steps:
1) Vanessa will propose the pricing/discount trade-offs tied to term length.
2) Marissa can hop on a call with your AP/ERP team to validate fields and DocuSign details.

Can we schedule 30 minutes tomorrow (Tue) at 11:00 PT for a short mapping call?

Best,
Rafael
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: REDWOOD_PO_Mapping_Checklist_2026.xlsx]

From: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@brightforge.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@brightforge.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 07:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing metadata & PO attribute checklist for Redwood deployment

On Mon, Jun 22, 2026 at 9:05 AM rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com wrote:
> Attached: REDWOOD_PO_Mapping_Checklist_2026.xlsx (maps your template fields to what our system emits) and a sample SOW for the committed capacity.

Thanks — that mapping file looks promising. A couple follow-ups from procurement: 

- Our ERP requires an explicit invoice field named "contract_code" (not contract_id). Is that something you can add to the invoice payload?
- We have multiple cost centers that need to be billed separately. Ideally we'd like separate invoices per cost center but grouped under one master PO. Do you support invoice splitting per cost center (i.e., multiple PDFs one invoice run)?
- Our policy is Net60 for strategic suppliers; however, it requires either a 25% deposit or a GM approval in our procurement system. Would Redwood accept Net60 with a 20% upfront deposit instead?

I've attached the PO template we sent so you can see the exact field names. If you can confirm these 3 items, procurement can draft the master PO and route it for signature.

Sarah Lang
Director, Strategic Procurement
Brightforge Inc.
[Attachment: BRIGHTFORGE_PO_Template_2026_v1.docx]

From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@brightforge.com>, rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing metadata & purchase-order attribute checklist for Brightforge deployment

Hi Sarah — Marissa from Finance here. Thanks for the template — I'm copying the key confirmations below and a recommended implementation approach: 

Confirmations:
- contract_code: yes, we can populate invoice.contract_code to match Brightforge's field name (we'll emit both contract_id and contract_code for compatibility during the onboarding month).
- Split invoices per cost center: supported. We can run a single invoice job that emits multiple invoice PDFs (one per cost center) linked by the master PO number. Our AP portal will list each PDF with reference back to the same Contract ID/PO.
- Net60 with deposit: we can accept Net60 if Brightforge provides a 20% upfront deposit. Finance needs to receive the deposit lock confirmation before the first invoice is issued; we will include that as a clause in the SOW/Order Form.

Recommended on-boarding steps (3 items):
1) Brightforge to provide final master PO with cost center mapping and expected monthly usage estimate per cost center.
2) Redwood issues Order Form + SOW (we'll include a clause for deposit and discount tiers).
3) Once signed and deposit received (if applicable), we will enable per-cost-center invoice runs and provide a test invoice (PDF) for ERP ingestion before production.

I attached the sample SOW and the mapping checklist with column comments for your ERP team. If you prefer, we can do a 30-min technical call to validate the test PDF fields. Rafael — please confirm pricing/discount tiers and I'll draft the deposit clause.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Finance (Revenue)
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOW-Redwood-Brightforge-2026.pdf]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
To: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@brightforge.com>, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, rafael_mendes@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:35:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing metadata & purchase-order attribute checklist for Brightforge deployment

Hi Sarah — Vanessa here. Quick note on pricing/packaging so procurement can see the trade-offs: 

Options we recommend:
- Option A (Best price): Annual committed spend -> 15% discount, billed annually or monthly with prepayment. Requires 20% deposit if you want Net60 on invoices.
- Option B (Mid): 6-month minimum commit -> 8% discount, monthly billing, Net45 standard without deposit.
- Option C (No commit): Pay-as-you-go -> no discount, monthly invoices only, Net30.

If Brightforge needs Net60 without deposit we can escalate to finance leadership but that will reduce the discount by ~3–5 percentage points.

I'll draft a brief redline for the Order Form reflecting the deposit clause and put a DocuSign powerform link in the draft. Rafael — please confirm preferred option so I can prepare the OF.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
[Link: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&id=abcd-1234]

From: Sarah Lang <sarah.lang@brightforge.com>

Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Billing metadata & purchase-order attribute checklist for Brightforge deployment

Thanks all — this is helpful and should let procurement move forward. A few final items before we route the PO for signature:

- We'll proceed with Option A (annual commit) contingent on the 15% discount and Net60 with 20% deposit. Procurement will add the deposit instruction to the PO and route for approval.
- Please include the following invoice-level fields in the test PDF: po_number, contract_code, cost_center, usage_period (YYYY-MM), invoice_total_usd. Those exact names are required by our ERP mapping.
- Our AP team requests that the PDF filename follow this pattern: BRIGHTFORGE_INV_<po_number>_<cost_center>_<YYYYMM>.pdf — can your invoice job be configured to emit that filename?

If you confirm the filename policy, we'll produce the master PO and loop in our GM for the final sign-off.

Sarah
Director, Strategic Procurement
Brightforge Inc.
